source.name: Terrain Tiles (Mapzen) on AWS Open Data — SRTM (NASA/USGS)

above_1000_note: share of THIS RECTANGULAR FRAME above 1,000 m, cos(lat)-weighted at z10 — the frame holds slivers of neighbouring provinces; this is not a statement about the two provinces' borders

method.highest_cell: candidates above 2400 m, highest first; a cell more than 300 m above all eight neighbours is a void-fill artifact and is skipped (3 skipped this read)
method.profile: median of three along the line
